answers.ma_evidence:
The matrices $B$ and $C$ are upper triangular matrices since all the entries below the main diagonal are zeros.

The matrix $A$ is *not* an upper triangular matrix since it has a non-zero element below the main diagonal: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{43} & =1\ne 0\end{aligned}
$$
